claims.text: Many reviewers report visible whitening and stain removal, often noticing results quickly or within a couple of weeks.
A common complaint is that the charcoal powder is very messy, getting all over the sink and counter.
Reviewers frequently praise the paste-and-powder bundle and say they would keep buying it.
Some users find the product works no better than regular toothpaste or leaves charcoal stuck between teeth.
Several reviewers note the product is gentle on gums and leaves teeth feeling clean.
